create_LoRALinearLayer: create a LoRALinearLayer with specified input features, output features, and rank for low-rank adaptation
create_LoRAConv2dLayer: create a LoRAConv2dLayer with configurable rank, kernel size, and stride for convolutional LoRA
create_PatchedLoraProjection: create a PatchedLoraProjection wrapping a linear layer with LoRA for text encoder fine-tuning
fuse_lora_weights: fuse LoRA weights into the base layer using _fuse_lora with a given scale and safe fusing option
adjust_lora_scale_text_encoder: adjust the LoRA scale across all attention and MLP modules in a CLIP text encoder
